$comment: Hand-set fields merged on top of what scripts/build-asset-index.mjs infers from file names. Keys are asset ids from data/assets.json. Confirmed by the portal owner: the UNICEF and UNICEF Digital Impact Division logos are brand di; the GEP and Connectivity Forum event logos are brand giga. The fonts (Manrope, Open Sans) are shared by both brands: brand both. The boxed UNICEF Digital Impact Division file named -black is the full-colour lockup (blue box, black text), so its colour is set to full-colour. Change any value here, then run npm run build or node scripts/build-asset-index.mjs.
